style: Voice acting for Pawnshire, a hand-painted storybook chess adventure with animal characters, for families. Warm, characterful, clearly spoken; never scary or mean. Speak only the given words.

narrator.direction: The storybook narrator: a warm, gentle British storyteller reading a picture book aloud at bedtime. Unhurried, kind and softly expressive, with a smile in the voice.

hob.direction: Sir Hob, a young frog knight: eager, brave and a little show-off, bouncy and quick, with a cheeky grin. Light British accent.

ollie.direction: Sage Ollie, an old owl scholar: patient and precise, with dry, gentle wit and a knowing smile. Calm, warm, slightly scholarly British accent.

brick.direction: Old Brick, an ancient tortoise: a deep, warm, steady voice, unhurried but never slow, few words, calm under pressure and quietly kind. Speaks at a natural pace.

saffron.direction: Saffron, the Fox Queen: confident, quick and a bit vain, elegant and playful, with a sly smile.

grubnak.direction: Grubnak, the Toad Chief: a big, loud, greedy goblin toad, deep, croaky and gravelly. Pompous and boastful, talks about himself in the third person, a comic bully, never truly scary.

ashfang.direction: Ashfang, the Bandit Lord: a smooth, velvet-voiced wolf, mocking and amused, who counts everything in coin. A charming thief, not a brute.

tadwell.direction: Tadwell, the Frog Captain: formal, dutiful and earnest, proud of the old army and a little stiff, with crisp military politeness.

cult-leader.direction: The Cult Leader: hushed, serene and certain, a soft breathy near-whisper that never rises. Calm and a little unsettling, not frightening.

flint.direction: General Flint, a proud old lion general: firm, clipped and commanding, gruff authority with dignity.

wardens.direction: The Bone Wardens, skeleton guards who speak as one: low, slow and hollow, quiet and watchful, very few words.

lich.direction: The Lich King, an ancient skeleton king: cold, quiet, courtly and measured, a dry, hollow voice with faded grandeur. Never raises his voice.

r1-p.direction: A sneaky little bog rat goblin: quick, squeaky and giggly, up to mischief.

r1-n.direction: A slippery, splashy salamander goblin knight: excitable and showy.

r1-b.direction: A beady-eyed crow goblin bishop: raspy, nosy and sly, peering about.

r1-r.direction: A slow, grumpy snapping-turtle goblin rook: heavy, muddy and stubborn.

r1-q.direction: A swamp viper goblin queen: sly, silky and theatrical, drawing out her s sounds.

r2-p.direction: A street-smart raccoon bandit: nimble, cheeky and relaxed.

r2-n.direction: A fast, cocky hare bandit knight: breezy and daring.

r2-b.direction: A chattering magpie bandit bishop: bright and greedy for shiny things.

r2-r.direction: A burly badger bandit rook: gruff, slow and good-humoured.

r2-q.direction: A sharp, cunning stoat bandit queen: cool and businesslike.

r3-p.direction: A soft moth cultist: a fluttery, hushed whisper, gentle and certain.

r3-n.direction: A quiet bat cultist knight: low and secretive.

r3-b.direction: A slow spider cultist bishop: silky, patient and mysterious.

r3-r.direction: A very slow snail cultist rook: drowsy, calm and solemn.

r3-q.direction: An elegant cat cultist queen: soft, purring and knowing.

r4-p.direction: A young hedgehog soldier of the Iron Legion: eager, dutiful recruit.

r4-n.direction: A bold boar cavalry knight of the Iron Legion: gruff, brave and hearty, speaking firmly at a normal volume, never shouting.

r4-b.direction: A calm heron officer of the Iron Legion: precise and observant.

r4-r.direction: A sturdy armadillo veteran of the Iron Legion: steady, proud and dry.

r4-q.direction: A proud eagle commander of the Iron Legion: crisp and commanding.

r5-p.direction: A small skeleton mouse guard: quiet, hollow and watchful.

r5-n.direction: A skeleton frog guard: soft, slow and hollow.

r5-b.direction: A skeleton owl guard: old, quiet and solemn.

r5-r.direction: A skeleton tortoise guard: very slow, deep and hollow.

r5-q.direction: A skeleton fox guard: cool, quiet and hollow.

finale-p.direction: A skeleton mouse servant of the Lich King: hushed, polite and cold.

finale-n.direction: A skeleton frog knight of the Lich King: slow, courtly and cold.

finale-b.direction: A skeleton owl bishop of the Lich King: quiet, courtly and patient.

finale-r.direction: A skeleton tortoise rook of the Lich King: deep, slow and solemn.

finale-q.direction: A skeleton fox queen of the Lich King: elegant, cool and wistful.

ally-p.direction: A brave little mouse pawn of Pawnshire: small, plucky and determined.

ally-n.direction: A bold frog knight soldier of Pawnshire: lively and confident.

ally-b.direction: A wise owl bishop of Pawnshire: clear, calm and pleased.

ally-r.direction: A sturdy tortoise rook of Pawnshire: steady, warm and firm.

ally-q.direction: A bright, confident fox queen of Pawnshire: quick and stylish.
